scope.experience: Ordinary web-grounded search and conversational follow-ups
scope.task: Research a public question, open the cited sources, and ask a follow-up comparing two findings.
scope.configuration: Core search experience; no Computer workflow, browser agent, deep research report or scheduled automation. No subscription/model was tested.

conversational.rationale: Natural-language questions and follow-ups form a flexible conversation centered on finding and synthesizing information.
conversational.uncertainty: Search grounding and a research focus constrain interaction compared with a completely unrestricted chat assistant.

specialization.rationale: The product emphasizes web information retrieval and synthesis across many subject areas rather than one domain or all-purpose task execution.
specialization.uncertainty: A broad-topic search tool is less specialized than a narrowly configured knowledge-base assistant.

autonomy.rationale: The system searches and combines sources for a question without the user directing every retrieval step, while the user sets the question and subsequent use.
autonomy.uncertainty: This does not include long-running digital-worker capabilities or external app actions.

accessibility.rationale: A question-and-answer experience reduces navigation effort for a broad audience, while checking sources still requires research and information-literacy skills.
accessibility.uncertainty: Access limits, available features and user needs vary; no direct accessibility/usability study was performed.

explainability.rationale: Linked citations give users an observable evidence trail and a way to compare generated claims with original material.
explainability.uncertainty: A citation can be incomplete or mismatched; linked evidence is not proof that a conclusion is accurate or that model reasoning is transparent.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: Perplexity core web search with citations and follow-ups, excluding Computer, Comet automation and Deep Research. Scores are design estimates. Source: https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/10352155-what-is-perplexity .
